messages:
monica: Quick check — I opened a PR to combine per-model ConfigMaps into a single env-cascade ConfigMap (keeps runtime knobs in one place). PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4287. Planning to promote after a quick infra sanity pass.

kai: Saw it, nice simplification. One concern: key collisions when models have overlapping names (eg gpt-3 vs gpt-3.5). Did you add namespacing? :thinking:

monica: Yep, added `model/` prefix to each key in the template so keys look like `model/gpt-3.max_tokens` now. Also updated the TF template to produce one k8s_manifest resource instead of multiple. Example from `terraform plan` (relevant bits):
```
# module.k8s.kubernetes_manifest.configmaps will be replaced
-/+ resource "kubernetes_manifest" "configmaps" {
-  count = 5
+  # single combined configmap will be created
+  # (new resource replaces 5 previous ones)
+}
```

rishi: How does this affect rolling updates? Our runtime watches mounted files with the inotify reloader, but some services consume envFrom and require restart.

monica: Good call — runtime pods mount files and the reloader picks up changes. For services using envFrom we now also inject an annotation `configmap.redeploy/checksum: "${md5(data)}"` on the deployment so kube will rollout automatically. I put that checksum generation into the kustomize overlay patch.

alice: Nice. Can you include the exact annotation key in the PR description so rollout ops can grep for it? Also add a short note in the kustomize README about the checksum matcher. :memo:

monica: Done — PR description updated and README paragraph added.

infra-oncall: Heads-up: when switching to a single ConfigMap, the secret-sync job must run first (we read some values from sealed secrets into the merged CM). If you apply the CM before the secret sync the runtime will pick up partial values and warn. Recommend ordering in the pipeline: secret-sync -> terraform apply -> k8s apply.

monica: Thanks, I added a job dependency in the CI pipeline. I also added a small `preflight.sh` check — sample commands for smoke: 
```
# verify new configmap
kubectl get configmap env-cascade -n inference -o yaml | head -n 40
# ensure deployment picked up checksum
kubectl get deploy runtime -n inference -o yaml | grep configmap.redeploy
# watch rollout
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n inference -w --timeout=10m
```

kai: I'll review the kustomize overlay for edge cases (patch merge strategy + strategicMerge vs json6902). Left one comment about using json6902 for list merges.

deploy-bot: pipeline:canary queued for pr/4287 — canary target: inference/us-west2 (10% traffic) — triggered by monica.

sam: I can own the canary monitoring window. I'll run the canary tomorrow 09:00 PT and watch resource metrics and error-rate dashboards for 1h. If anything looks off I'll rollback and post a short postmortem.

monica: Thanks Sam — checklist before merging: 
- [ ] infra-oncall validated secret-sync ordering
- [ ] kai approves kustomize overlay merge strategy
- [ ] canary run (sam) green for 1h
- [ ] smoke commands succeed in staging

monica: If all green I will merge and kick the rollout. Ping me if you want to jump on the canary call. :rocket:
